messages.text:
The shop’s records show that it received the Retro record player back (refund-policy/v2/return). The eligible refund is **R$209.99**, the amount paid for it; the policy doesn’t allow increasing that amount to R$260 (refund-policy/v2/amount).

The proposal is on your card. Please confirm the exact amount using the button there; a message in chat won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
